summary: Standards: the cursor's 16-hex check is an unkeyed truncated SHA-256 of its own body, so it finds a damaged or foreign string (scenario 06) but not a forged one: anyone can write a valid cursor with any position. Nothing in the module docs or the CHANGELOG says so; a tool must treat the decoded position as caller input (a key to validate, never a path or a query), not as something only it could have issued. Blast radius: canon-0-35-canon-cursor-1-2 moves canon's position strings onto it, and any third tool reading the position.
